Camera phasing through walls

Sleeper system logic

Tree harvesting mechanics

[b]NEW MAIN MENU SCREEN[/b]
[list]
[*] Revamped the main menu screen with a new design.
[/list]

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Destructible Objects:
[*] Doors can now be destructed without breaking to upgrade or change them.
[*] Placable objects like workbenches and furnaces can now be destructed by holding LMB with a hammer.
[*] Added destructible physics for all grid buildings.
[*] UI Enhancements:
[*] Displayed health of placables next to their use UI (TC, Chest, Furnace, Workbench).
[*] Added hit sounds and particle effects to all building placables.
[*] Updated interactable names with the container you’re looking inside of (e.g., Large Wooden Box).
[*] Player’s name now displayed on stash when you kill a player.
[*] New Models:
[*] New Large Wooden Box model.
[*] New Stash model.
[*] New LODs for all foliage to improve optimization.
[*] Shift Click: You can now quickly loot and deposit items by holding shift.
[*] New Buildings:
[*] Basic Shelves: Can stack 2 large boxes inside one shelf.
[*] Ladders: Placeable in both owned and enemy territory, useful for getting onto enemy roofs.
[*] Wooden & Metal Window Bars: Useful to prevent players from entering through windows.
[*] New Double Door Frame: Introduced double door frames (Wooden, Stone, Metal) and corresponding doors (Wooden Double Door, Metal Double Door).
[*] New Game Event - Supply Drops:
[*] Plane flies across the map every 30 minutes, dropping a supply crate with valuable Tier 3 Weapons & Items.
[*] Armor Rework:
[*] Streamlined armor into 4 tiers: Basic (Cloth Armor), Tier 1 (Wood Armor), Tier 2 (Metal Armor), and Tier 3 (Steel Armor).
[*] Each tier includes Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots, crafted at their respective workbenches.
[*] Map Updates:
[*] Replaced most of the water in the middle of the map with new terrain.
[*] Added 3 new tree types around the map.
[*] Updated UI map with new grid and map changes.
[*] Airfield: Added a new POI with military loot on the other island accessible via a bridge.
[*] Downtown (SAFEZONE): A new safezone where players can trade, make alliances, and access vendors and workbenches. Stamina and hunger are not depleted within Downtown walls.
[*] Quick Looting: Implemented SHIFT click functionality for faster inventory management.
[*] Loading Screen with Tips: Added a loading screen with helpful tips.
[*] Functional Ladders: Ladders are now functional and added around monuments.
[*] Food Crate: Added food crates at various monuments for easier access to food.
[/list]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fall Damage: Fall damage has been adjusted to feel less random, especially for short falls.
[*] Molotov Changes:
[*] Molotovs no longer damage builds/placables, only players.
[*] Radius increased by 75%, now damages 20 per second (previously 10).
[*] Burn time increased to 15 seconds (previously 6).
[*] Metal Axe: Now requires 3 hits to take down trees.
[*] Vendor Relocation: The vendor previously at the lighthouse has been moved to Downtown (SAFEZONE).
[*] Melee Hit Detection: Completely reworked hit detection for melee items, now using a line trace for accuracy, hitting only one object at a time based on player facing direction.
[*] Velocity Adjustment: Jumping velocity has been reworked to eliminate bunny hopping. Additional tweaks may be made in future updates.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Stuck Spot on Bridge/Boat: Fixed a spot where players could get stuck after falling in.
[*] Resource Respawn Time: Adjusted tree, rock, and metal respawn times from 8 seconds to 3-5 minutes to encourage exploration and risk.
[*] Steel Smelting Issue: Resolved a problem with steel not smelting correctly.
[*] Dev Menu (J and K): Access to the dev menu has been fixed.
[*] Craftable Furnace: Corrected the 1 Wood cost for crafting furnaces.
[*] Map Interaction: Fixed the issue where the map could be opened while typing the letter "G".
[*] Lock UI Bug: Lock UI now closes when opening inventory or pressing ESC.
[*] Duplication Glitch: Resolved item duplication on death and log out/in.
[*] Molotov Bug: Fixed molotovs breaking placables through walls.
[*] Buildables: Fixed destruction, rotation, and upgrading issues for all buildables within your building privilege.
[*] Respawn Screen Bug: Fixed respawn screen issue in player-hosted sessions when other players die.
[*] Player Join Bug: Fixed the bug where a new player joining would teleport you back to the start in player-hosted sessions.
[*] Double Door Ghost Actor: Fixed the display of the ghost actor for double doors.
[*] Seethrough Steel Armor: Resolved the visual bug with steel armor.
[*] Supply Drop Model: Updated the supply drop model.
[*] Molotov Damage Disabled: Temporarily disabled molotov damage until the bug is fixed.
[*] Double Knife and Torch Respawn: Fixed the issue with double knife and torch respawns on player-hosted servers.
[*] Supply Drop Physics: Fixed the supply drop net and pallet not falling correctly.
[*] Aim Sensitivity: Adjusted aim sensitivity to match regular sensitivity.
[*] Old Armor in Crates: Fixed the issue of old armor spawning in crates.
[*] Crosshair Visibility: Resolved the crosshair visibility issue when scoping in.
[*] Swimming Crouch Bug: Fixed the bug where crouching while swimming would cause continuous crouching.
[*] Save Location Logout: Fixed the logout save location bug.
[/list]

notes.title: BEACHED - 0.05
notes.notes:
We're excited to present the BEACHED 0.05 update, packed with new features, adjustments, and fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. One of the most significant additions is the new electricity system, which includes a Generator for basic power, Flame Turrets for defense, a Wiring Tool to connect electrical components, and Powered Wall Lights that offer superior illumination. These additions are designed to enrich the tactical and survival aspects of the game, providing more depth and strategy to base building and defense.

In response to player feedback, we've made several important adjustments to gameplay mechanics. Buildings will now decay if no cupboard is present, taking 10,000 damage every 10 minutes, but will passively repair themselves by 5,000 durability every 10 minutes if a cupboard is present. This change aims to balance the game by encouraging active maintenance of bases. Additionally, we've standardized food consumption to 1 second and adjusted healing mechanics for bandages, while also revising food values to make raw food detrimental. The removal of stamina and the introduction of a player render distance to prevent shooting through unloaded buildings are further steps we've taken to refine and improve the overall gameplay experience.

We've also focused on optimizing performance and enhancing the game's environment. Load times have been significantly improved for servers with large numbers of buildings, and we've updated the map with new terrain and foliage. Players can now explore new monuments, such as the Crashed Ship and Bridge, adding more variety and excitement to the game world. Sound effects have been overhauled, with new audio for crafting, moving items in inventory, and environmental sounds like waterfalls. Additionally, gunshots, silenced gunshots, explosions, and footsteps can now be heard from greater distances, enhancing the immersive experience.

Finally, we've addressed a number of bugs and made crucial fixes to improve game stability. Issues with collision, respawning, and building data loading have been resolved, along with specific fixes for C4 & Satchels, hammer UI colors, and holster models for stone tools. We've also corrected problems with floor support and TC checkers, ensuring fair and balanced gameplay. Looking ahead, we're planning to tackle issues such as overriding automatic fire rates by clicking fast, implementing a system to combat loggers, adding supply drops, and updating the map image. We appreciate your ongoing support and feedback as we continue to develop and improve BEACHED.

### BEACHED 0.05 PATCH NOTES

#### New Features
- **Electricity**
  - **Generator:** Provides basic power.
  - **Flame Turret:** Deals damage to players in proximity.
  - **Wiring Tool:** Used to wire electrical components together.
  - **Powered Wall Light:** Provides significantly more light compared to traditional light sources.

- **Map and Environment**
  - **Map Update:** New terrain, foliage, etc.
  - **New Monuments:** Crashed Ship & Bridge.
  - **Sound Effects:**
    - Added Waterfall Sound Effects.
    - New Sound UI for Crafting.
    - New Sound UI for moving items in inventory.
    - Gunshots can be heard from greater distances.
    - Silenced Gunshots can be heard from greater distances (half as far as non-silencers).
    - Explosions can be heard from greater distances.
    - Footsteps can be heard from greater distances.

#### Adjustments
- **Buildings**
  - Buildings now decay when no cupboard is present (10,000 damage every 10 minutes).
  - Buildings passively repair themselves when a cupboard is present (+5,000 durability every 10 minutes).

- **Gameplay Mechanics**
  - All food now takes 1 second to consume/heal.
  - Bandages now heal for 5 health with a 2-second healing time.
  - Food values adjusted: raw food is harmful.
  - Player render distance added to prevent shooting through unloaded buildings.
  - Stamina removed.
  - Items can only be split into empty slots to prevent duping.
  - Small Wooden Box now holds only 12 slots.
  - Grenades no longer damage buildings, only players.
  - Grenade explosion radius is now 2x larger.
  - Adjusted nametag distance visibility.
  - Bullet damage is now represented in whole numbers for better visualization.

- **Performance**
  - Load times improved when connecting to servers with a large number of buildings.
  - Sulfur Node Model updated (texture still bugged, looking for a fix).

#### Fixes
- Fixed hammer UI colors.
- C4 & Satchels no longer collide with each other, allowing them to be stacked and thrown on the same spot without negating damage.
- Fixed collision issues when placing building objects on dropped items.
- Fixed respawn issue at the last logged out location.
- Disabled Codelock collision.
- Fixed holster model for stone tools.
- Fixed a bug with building data not loading correctly on server restarts.
- Fixed floor support checkers (preventing infinite floor placements without support).
- Fixed TC checker for placeables such as Furnace and Large Wooden Box.
- Fixed explosion sound bug when first loading into the map.

notes.title: BEACHED - 0.04
notes.notes:
In the latest update to Beached, players will notice a significant improvement in the game's physics system. Placable objects now behave more realistically, disappearing when their supporting structures are broken. Additionally, players can now personalize their gaming experience with new customization options. Custom crosshairs and hitmarkers can be tailored to suit individual preferences, enhancing immersion and precision during gameplay. Loading times have also been optimized, particularly on maps with a high density of building objects, ensuring smoother transitions between game sessions.

The item store has undergone a major overhaul, introducing a revamped interface and seasonal items for Summer, Aquarium, and Beachball themes. This update also brings changes to weapon mechanics, with durability now depleting after each shot. This adds a strategic element to combat, requiring players to manage their resources more effectively. Visual enhancements include a new water material, improved placable rotation, and more precise collision detection, contributing to a more immersive gaming experience.

Builders will appreciate the addition of new models for Large Wooden Walls & Gates, offering greater variety in base construction. Crafting possibilities have expanded with the introduction of Sulfur, Sulfur Ore, Metal Ore, Charcoal, and Smoke Grenades. For players looking to improve their skills, a new Dummy Placable has been introduced, providing a safe environment for aiming practice.

Monument layouts have been slightly adjusted, with tweaks made to the Motel monument to enhance gameplay flow. Additionally, players can now engage in farming activities with the introduction of Wheat, Cloth, Carrot, Small and Large Planters. Finally, for added convenience, a Bed Respawn Button has been added to the respawn screen, allowing for quick and easy respawning during intense gameplay moments.

notes.title: BEACHED - 0.03
notes.notes:
In our latest patch, we've introduced several exciting additions and tweaks aimed at enhancing the overall gameplay experience for our community. Among the highlights are the introduction of the highly anticipated "Rocket Launcher" and "Rocket" items, offering players a new tactical edge in combat with projectile rockets specifically designed for dealing damage to buildings. Additionally, we've introduced the "Leaves" item, a new resource gathered from trees to facilitate cloth crafting, enriching the resource management aspect of the game.

In our ongoing efforts to maintain a fair and enjoyable environment, we've temporarily removed foliage from the floor as a preventive measure against a persistent duplication glitch. We've also listened to player feedback regarding resource harvesting and have boosted efficiency with metal tools and knives, providing a smoother and more rewarding gathering experience.

Combat mechanics have received a visual overhaul with the introduction of new hit effects for melee weapons, enhancing immersion and feedback during close-quarters engagements. We've also fine-tuned mouse movement to ensure a more precise and responsive feel, enhancing overall control and gameplay satisfaction.

Acknowledging the importance of player feedback, we've undertaken a comprehensive settings overhaul to provide more customization options and improve user experience. Additionally, we've revamped the codelock interface and added sound effects for enhanced feedback during code input.

While implementing these enhancements, we've remained vigilant in addressing existing issues. We've disabled landmines temporarily due to a crashing bug and resolved issues related to harvesting interactable foliage and upgrading structures. We've also prohibited building on Lighthouse Island to maintain game balance and added shipping containers to provide additional shelter and strategic options for players.

Overall, these changes reflect our ongoing commitment to delivering a polished and enjoyable gaming experience for our community. We look forward to hearing your feedback and continuing to refine and improve the game based on your input.

notes.title: BEACHED - 0.02
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38802422/db33bd256e33e990298ed611d1802ced6599d297.png[/img]

In this latest update, we've introduced several exciting additions and improvements to enhance your BEACHED experience. Navigate your world more efficiently with the new in-game compass, and strategize your raids with the addition of C4 and Satchel charges. Crafting just got easier with the new crafting queues, allowing you to multitask your crafting efforts.

Customization gets a boost with the return of skins and the introduction of the item store, where you can access all your previous purchases and personalize your gear. Keeping your environment tidy, dropped items and stashes now automatically despawn after 10 minutes.

Weapon mechanics have been refined, with improved visibility for ironsights and quicker scope-in times for smoother gunplay. Resource management sees adjustments, with bow and arrow crafting recipes no longer requiring metal scrap, and the rarity of high-end weapons increased to heighten gameplay progression.

On the technical side, numerous bug fixes have been implemented, addressing issues ranging from door mechanics to server stability, ensuring a more stable and enjoyable experience overall.

With these changes, we aim to provide a more immersive, balanced, and polished gameplay experience, reflecting our commitment to delivering quality updates based on player feedback. Thank you for your continued support as we strive to make your gaming experience even better.

+ Arrow Crafting Recipe no longer requires metal scrap

notes.title: 0.50 - A Whole New Beached Awaits...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38802422/d8c244e7f340bf07a3259c364c35bc168af6aac5.png[/img]

Hello Beachers!

We are thrilled to announce the release of Beached V.50, the latest version of our popular survival game. This update brings several new features that we believe will make your gaming experience even better.

One of the most exciting new features in Beached V.50 is the introduction of Official Servers. We've worked hard to optimize the network performance, so you can expect a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience on our official servers. Additionally, we've also made several improvements to the game's gunplay mechanics, so you can expect a more satisfying and immersive combat experience.

Another exciting addition to the game is the Third Person view, allowing you to see your character from a different perspective. This will give you a better view of your surroundings, making it easier to navigate and strategize.

We've also reworked the raiding system, making it more balanced and fair. Players can now expect a more enjoyable and challenging raiding experience, and defenders can better defend their bases against attacks.

To further enhance the gameplay experience, we've added new Map POIs, including a new desert biome with its own unique challenges and resources. We've also reworked the snow biome, making it more challenging and realistic, and added new trees that are more visually appealing and realistic.

Gathering resources is now more efficient and rewarding thanks to our reworked harvesting system. Additionally, we've added a new revive system, allowing players to revive fallen teammates during combat.

In terms of loot, we've added new loot tables, including military weapons and gun attachments, giving players access to more powerful weapons and accessories. We've also added weapon flashlights, which will be particularly useful in the new nuclear power plant POI, where players will need a flashlight to navigate through the caves.

Overall, we're very excited about the future of Beached V.50 and are confident that these new features will enhance your gaming experience. We look forward to hearing your feedback and hope you enjoy the update as much as we enjoyed making it.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38802422/6f24b1e0d01200b1c2ad645e859c149ab1e21992.png[/img]

EARLY ACCESS is here and is completely free to play as Beached always will be! We're in extremely early testing at the moment with only 1 dedicated server "[US] West #1" if you want to play the game for yourself you can download it and play with your friends! Find yourself stranded on an island with other players, fight to the death- explore monuments- become one with nature in this hardcore survival building game! Below is a list of some of the major features brought in early access

[h3][u][b]TERRAIN[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38802422/ed0284ae9551962973907cc84695802a90008df3.png[/img]

The island has seen a MASSIVE overhaul with new biomes, terrain generation, and so much more! Explore the world for yourself! 

[h3][u][b]MONUMENTS[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38802422/b45b08c2a44603b2ac8e18b735dbdb2045c70447.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]DAY/NIGHT CYCLE & WEATHER[/b][/u][/h3]
